periods.label: Sun 8 Nov
periods.text: Southwesterly 25 to 30 knots tending southerly in the early morning. 2.5 to 3 metres. Southerly 2 to 3 metres. Cloudy. 90% chance of showers. The chance of a thunderstorm offshore during the morning and afternoon.

periods.label: Mon 9 Nov
periods.text: Southerly 15 to 25 knots, reaching up to 30 knots offshore north of Moruya Heads during the morning. Winds decreasing to 10 to 15 knots in the late evening. 1.5 to 2.5 metres. Southerly 2.5 to 3 metres, tending southeasterly 2 to 4 metres during the morning. Southerly 1 to 2 metres, decreasing below 0.5 metres around midday. Cloudy. 60% chance of showers. Large and powerful surf conditions are expected to be hazardous for coastal activities such as crossing bars by boat and rock fishing.
